thresholds.rapid: NT10: 10% of item mean first-answer time (on-task), capped at 10 s
thresholds.pool_retention: export item only if bias-corrected a >= 0.25 and |b| <= 4.0; a < 0.25 means b is not identified. Data-quality rule fixed before any detector result on calibrated data was seen; item_prior uses the retained pool only

source.note: Calibrated on EdNet-KT2 TOEIC Part-5 calibration users (hash split; evaluation users never read), fit subset only. EdNet is a self-study tutor, not an exam. Times are first-answer times (enter -> first respond). gap = next enter - last respond of the previous item (includes the per-item submit tap and reading the explanation). EdNet has no end-of-quiz review: review = time from the last respond of the 20th item to its submit (the per-item submit lag), i.e. it is NOT a review phase. Item parameters are JML/MAP 3PL with parametric-bootstrap bias correction; see ml/ednet/calibration_report.md.
